rawFindings.title: Incorrect handling of undefined generator return values in Hexo.prototype._generate
rawFindings.explanation: In Hexo.prototype._generate, when a generator returns nothing (undefined), the code concatenates undefined to the result array, causing the result to become undefined and likely crashing subsequent code. The fix replaces `return data ? result.concat(data) : data;` with `return data ? result.concat(data) : result;` to maintain the accumulator type as an array regardless of generator output.
rawFindings.suggestion: Change the return statement in Hexo.prototype._generate from `return data ? result.concat(data) : data;` to `return data ? result.concat(data) : result;`.

rawFindings.title: Missing type check for generator return values in Hexo.prototype._generate
rawFindings.explanation: In Hexo.prototype._generate, the generator item is assumed to be an object with a path property when adding routes. If a generator returns a non-object or undefined, accessing item.path causes an error. Adding a type check prevents runtime exceptions on invalid generator output.
rawFindings.suggestion: Add a check to ensure `item` is an object before accessing `item.path` in Hexo.prototype._generate, e.g., `if (typeof item !== 'object' || item.path == null) return;` before processing routes.
